item.sophisticatedairtank.pressurized_ai:
Replaces part of backpack's inventory with pressurized air storage.
Place the backpack and connect a rotating vertical shaft above it to refill air.
Note that backpack's most functionality is disabled during air refilling.
item.sophisticatedairtank.create_jetpack: Aside from the functionality of a pressurized air upgrade, this upgrade also makes your backpack a jetpack.
gui.sophisticatedairtank.error.pressuriz: Only one Pressurized Air Upgrade can be installed.
gui.sophisticatedairtank.error.battery_c: The Pressurized Air Upgrade and Battery Upgrade are mutually exclusive.
gui.sophisticatedairtank.error.air_too_h: Stored air requires at least a x%s stack multiplier.
